newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean bank workers to strike next Saturday - union.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean bank workers to strike next Saturday - union.

text.p: Workers at South Korea's central bank and all other banks around the country will stage a one-day strike next Saturday in protest at a new labour law, a union leader said on Saturday.
Hyun Ki-hwan, vice president of a bank union group, said a decision on whether to extend the strike further would be made later.
Starting immediately, bank tellers and other unionised staff would refuse to wear uniforms.
The union body, under the officially-recognised Federation of Korean Trade Unions, claims to represent 132,000 workers at banks and mutual savings firms.
Bank workers feel particularly vulnerable to layoffs, authorised under the new labour law, as financial market opening is expected to spark a wave of mergers in the industry.
